title: How Scientists Hedge Their Claims
text:
Scientists rarely state their findings with absolute certainty. Instead, they tend to use hedges such as 'may', 'appear to', and 'it is possible that', which signal that a claim is provisional. Such language is not a sign of weakness; it reflects the honest recognition that new data could later revise an interpretation.

Yet excessive hedging can frustrate readers, who may come to believe that the author has nothing definite to say. Skilled writers therefore balance caution with clarity, qualifying claims only where the evidence genuinely requires it. The result is a text that is both accurate and authoritative.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do hedges such as 'may' and 'appear to' signal?
options: That the author is completely certain
That some data is missing entirely

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what can excessive hedging make readers believe?
options: That the author is extremely confident
That the author has nothing definite to say
That the text is too short

questions.text: Why does the author describe hedging as an honest recognition rather than a weakness?
options: Because new data could later revise an interpretation
Because hedging protects the author from all criticism
Because hedges make texts shorter and easier to read
Because readers prefer uncertainty to clear claims

questions.text: What is the author's overall view of skilled writers' use of hedges?
options: They should hedge every claim equally
They should balance caution with clarity
They should replace hedges with statistics

vocabulary.definition: temporary and open to change in the light of new information
words that make a claim less strong or less certain
more than is reasonable or necessary
showing confidence and knowledge that others trust

paragraph_translations: Bilim insanları bulgularını nadiren mutlak bir kesinlikle ifade eder. Bunun yerine, bir iddianın geçici olduğunu gösteren 'may', 'appear to' ve 'it is possible that' gibi çekinceler kullanma eğilimindedirler. Bu tür bir dil zayıflığın değil, yeni verilerin bir yorumu sonradan değiştirebileceğinin dürüstçe kabul edilmesinin işaretidir.

Yine de aşırı çekince kullanmak, yazarın kesin bir şey söyleyecek hiçbir şeyi olmadığını düşünmeye yol açabilen okuyucuları hayal kırıklığına uğratabilir. Becerikli yazarlar bu nedenle ihtiyatı açıklıkla dengeler ve iddialarını yalnızca kanıtların gerçekten gerektirdiği yerlerde sınırlar. Ortaya çıkan metin hem doğru hem de yetkin olur.
